Build20 free-prefix bit generators with8 parity bits. For each next prefix generator, require distance>=3 from earlier subspace: only prefix differences of weight1 or2 can violate this. Enumerate all5-digit prefix patterns with1/2 nonzero nibbles whose leading bit is the current bit, evaluate earlier parity via existing generators. Weight1 forbids an entire parity row and column; weight2 forbids one parity pair. Choose smallest remaining pair. Resulting systematic q^5 code has one codeword per5-digit prefix; its20-bit generator construction is lex greedy, not a guessed GF16 multiplication table. Independently validate full code minimum distance through all low-symbol-weight prefix differences and compare early literal greedy serial enumeration.
